title: Remove Trailing Zeros From a String
summary: Given a positive integer num as a string, remove any trailing zeros and return the resulting string representation of the integer.
statement: Given a positive integer num as a string, remove any trailing zeros and return the resulting string representation of the integer.
constraints: num is the ordinary decimal representation of a positive integer.
Remove every zero at the end of the string and no other character.
Return the remaining nonempty decimal string.
hints: Use a right-side strip restricted to the character zero.
The positive-integer representation contains a nonzero digit, so only the maximal zero suffix is removed and the result remains nonempty.
editorial: The positive-integer representation contains a nonzero digit, so only the maximal zero suffix is removed and the result remains nonempty.

There is no trailing zero, so the string is unchanged.
